mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 80 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, plus a full moon tonight and an air quality index of 58.

City officials remind us that road work at the Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive intersection begins August 5, and don't forget to vote for your favorite student-designed I Voted sticker online before the deadline on August 7.
There is a busy schedule today including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory, with Concerts in the Park taking place tomorrow.
In a report from this past week, on Wednesday, July 22, two juveniles were cited for operating e-motos on Lincoln Street and were warned regarding reckless driving.

The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup and the store is open until 10 PM. You can also grab a refreshing treat from the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4:30 PM or at the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
